blurb: Dillon Mulroy is a software engineer and functional programming enthusiast, known for his talk 'Maybe OCaml Was the Friends We Made Along the Way' at FUN OCaml 2024. He posts about OCaml, programming languages, and developer experiences. His X profile is @dillon_mulroy, but follower count is not available from sources.
